payload.text: **THE WEB FACE IS AN `intentsvcs` SURFACE WITH TWO SKINS, AND IT IS SERVED BY THE SAME SERVICE CALL THE CLI REACHES.** `intentd` serves it while running and `intent daemon run` serves the identical code in the foreground -- **which is `AC-08.2` restated for a second surface rather than a new promise**: in-process and daemon must return identical results, so a web face that answers from anywhere else has reversed D32. **RESOLUTION IS SIBLING-ONLY, NARROWED FROM THE DELIVERABLE AND RECORDED HERE BECAUSE THE DELIVERABLE CANNOT BE EDITED** (cc's finding, ruled by vc 2026-08-30). WP-08's text says *PATH-then-sibling binary resolution*, borrowed from conflabd's pattern. **The `$PATH` read broke `AC-11.3`'s guard** -- the shipped surface reads exactly one environment variable, because a brew-installed binary meets machines with no developer environment -- **and a criterion outranks a pattern description.** More importantly the search was the ONLY way to resolve a DIFFERENT `intentd`, which is the failure `exec` created: **removing it removes the failure mode instead of checking for it**, and in every real installation (homebrew, `cargo install`, a target directory) the pair are already siblings. **THE VERSION CHECK STAYS REGARDLESS**, because a sibling can still be stale from a build where only one of the pair was rebuilt -- one failure mode eliminated, the other still guarded. **This is `0154`'s second live instance: the WP body still says PATH-then-sibling and no verb can edit it**, so the correction lives in the row that gates instead of the prose that describes, and a reader meeting the deliverable alone will be told something no longer true. **A realiser holding a `rusqlite` dependency fails by construction** (`AC-02.5`, and `dep_graph_guard.rs` already enforces D06 for `intentd`). **MINTED 2026-08-29 BY vc, ON cc's FINDING, AND THE FINDING IS THE REASON THIS ROW EXISTS: the web view was scoped in conversation, carried in three sessions' instructions and on two boards, and appeared in NO criterion** -- so the gate would have computed WP-08 satisfaction without ever seeing it. **Scope that arrives through conversation and never reaches the artefact is invisible to every instrument the estate owns.**
